sourceSentences: Footwork can also be cast on allies with increased range and speed, and the ability to dash through terrain.
K'Sante dashes to the target location, though not through terrain, and grants himself a shield for 2 seconds.
K'Sante can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
Ntofo Strikes and All Out can be cast during the dash. Path Maker's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Path Maker's charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control.
Path Maker's recast can be used even while grounded or rooted, but the initial cast cannot.
Upon entering All Out, Path Maker's cooldown is refreshed.
Ntofo Strikes' cooldown is reset if K'Sante had 2 stacks before entering All Out.
pulling the target to a location that is 300 units in the cast direction from their location at the time of cast
If the target resists the pull by having a spell shield or being cc-immune or displacement immune, K'Sante will still blink beyond the pull's end location as if the target were displaced.
Spell shield will block the mark's application, but not the mark's consumption from an attack.
